THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K.SAHOO  THE HON'BLE MISS JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO  ORDER Order No. 12.03.2025 01.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners Smt. Draupadi Sahu and Smt. Saraswati Behera with a prayer for a direction to the Land Acquisition Officer -cum- LA, Collector (S.I.P), Bahalda not to disburse the compensation amount towards acquisition of land appertaining to plot no.516, out of Ac.1.15 decimals from schedule 'B' and Ac. 0.52 decimals from plot no.515 out of Ac.1.85 decimals from Schedule 'C' in favour of the brothers of the petitioners.

When we put a pertinent question to the learned counsel for the petitioners that who are the brothers of the petitioners, learned counsel submits that after filing of the writ petition on 12.02.2025, the petitioners have filed a written application before the Collector under section 64 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for making reference to the authority, inter alia, for deciding the person to whom the compensation amount towards the acquisition of land by Subarna Rekha Irrigation Project (S.I.P), Bahalada for irrigation purpose is payable, however, there is no averment to that effect in the writ petition, he seeks two weeks' time to file appropriate application for amendment of the writ petition.
